name: sprite_builder_create_docuspace
description: Create a Docuspace: an S3-backed file store for a project (no sprite, no worker — creation is instant). Use to store/serve files (markdown, images, assets). Optional name. Requires the server's S3_* env configured; otherwise file ops 400 with 'S3 is not configured'.

project_id.description: The project's id (UUID, from sprite_builder_list_projects / sprite_builder_create_project).
